mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fcc_agent_presence( agent_id, login_status, work_status, login_at, last_state_at ) VALUES(#{agentId}, 'LOGIN', 'READY', UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE login_status = 'LOGIN', work_status = CASE WHEN active_call_id IS NULL AND work_status IN ('UNREADY', 'READY', 'BUSY', 'REST') THEN 'READY' ELSE work_status END, login_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), last_state_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), version = version + 1
mapper.update: UPDATE fcc_agent_presence p JOIN fcc_agent a ON a.id = p.agent_id SET p.login_status = 'LOGOUT', p.work_status = CASE WHEN p.active_call_id IS NULL AND p.work_status IN ('READY', 'BUSY', 'REST', 'UNREADY') THEN 'UNREADY' ELSE p.work_status END, p.last_state_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), p.version = p.version + 1 WHERE a.work_no = #{workNo} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select:
